tatrādāvaṣṭamirvairāgyapratiṣṭhāyāṃ satyāṃ yāni lakṣaṇāni bhavanti tānyāha -
rūḍhe ityādinā

yathā pānthānāṃ dṛṣṭyā upayuktā api bhāṇḍopaskarā voḍhumaśaktyā hātuṃ
bhārāya dṛśyante tadvadviraktenāpi dārāśca bandhavaśca dṛśyanta ityarthaḥ
tarhi kiṃ sahasaiva tyajyante netyāha - yathāśaktīti
āsthīyate āsthāvatā bhūyate āsaktyabhāvācciraṃ na sthīyata iti vā
daivādāsthitenāpi tatra tatra jñātā tattvavideva jñānadārḍhyāyānviṣyate

athavā
jñātā dehendriyabuddhyādīnāṃ sākṣāddraṣṭā pratyagātmaiva cetasānviṣyate na
tadvyatiriktaṃ kiṃcidityarthaḥ
evaṃ nirantarānveṣaṇe'vaśyaṃ svātmadarśanena viśrāntiḥ siddhyatītyāha - evamiti

kīdṛśaṃ tatpadaṃ yatrāsya viśrāntiḥ kīdṛśaniścayātmikā ca sā tadāha -
sabāhyābhyantaramiti

ajñatā svājñānamevā'rthatayā dṛśyavargākāreṇoditā sā ca
bhinno'rtho na saṃbhavatīti śāntā sā śāntireva paramaṃ padamityarthaḥ

athavā
sabāhyābhyantaraṃ bhinno'rtho na saṃbhavatītyeva niścayarūpā jñatā
caramasākṣātkāravṛttireva dagdhendhanāgnivaccidātmani śāntā cettadeva paramaṃ
padamityarthaḥ
iti anubhūtau svānubhave sarvabādhāvadhitvena sthitaṃ yattadeva paramaṃ padamityarthaḥ
tasya paramapadasya na bodhatā na śūnyatā nāpyarthateti viddhi

sarvasya
vastujātasyaikenādvayena bodhenaivātiśayitaḥ saṃbandho'tisaṃbandha ātyantikaikarasyaṃ
tathā pariṇāmāt

na hi bodhyābhāve tadvyāvṛttā bodhatāpyapadeṣṭuṃ śakyā nāpi
tadarthatā tasyaiva vyapadeṣṭuṃ śakyā nāpyarthaśūnyatāmātreṇa bodhasya
śūnyatāprasaktiriti bhāvaḥ

yathā amanasāṃ
dṛṣadāṃ kṣīrāṇi na svadante tadvat

bahirmukhacittānāṃ svātmapravaṇatāṃ svātmaviśrāntānāṃ ca bahirmukhatāṃ
niruṇaddhīti nirodhastathāvidhaṃ padam
kīdṛśaṃ tadā tasya mano bhavati tadāha - sarvārthamiti

vedyamavaśyavedanīyamātmatattvaṃ vedituṃ śīlaṃ yasya tathāvidhasya tasya hṛdayaṃ
manaḥ artharahitameva satsarvārthaṃ bhavati
aśūnyameva śūnyātma iti śeṣaṃ vyācaṣṭe - ahaṃtvamiti

yato jñānādi
atastattayā sthitameva yataśca śūnyādi ato na vidyate - nāsato vidyate bhāvo
nābhāvo vidyate sataḥ iti nyāyāditi bhāvaḥ

tacca sarvaṃ prati sarvaprakāreṇa svātmana
eva saṃbhavatītyupapattimāha - tasmai iti

itthaṃn sarvathā sarvadā sarvātmanastasyaiva sarvathāpi sarvotkarṣātsa
eveśvara iti namaskārya ityāha - tasmai iti
ata eva śrutiprasiddhaṃ janmādihetutālakṣaṇaṃ tasyetyāśayenāha - tasmāditi

sa eva mahādevaḥ śubhehitaiḥ sukṛtaiḥ prasannaḥ san bodhāya tattvajñānādhānāya
pūtaṃn viśuddhatamaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ dūtaṃn prerayati preṣayati

tenātmanā devena saṃprerito viveko nāma dūtaḥ prāguktādhikāriṇo
hṛdguhāyāmāgatya tiṣṭhati yāvajjñānapratiṣṭhaṃ sthirībhavati
sa vivekadūtaḥ yadbodhayati tadeva tasya tāraṇamityāśayaḥ
eṣa sarvajagatprathāhetutvena prasiddho bodhātmaivāntarātmā na vāsanātmā

tathā ca śrutiḥ - agnirmūrdhā cakṣuṣī candrasūryau diśaḥ
śrotre vāgvivṛtāśca vedāḥ

vāyuḥ prāṇo hṛdayaṃn viśvamasya padbhyāṃ
pṛthivī hyeṣa sarvabhūtāntarātmā iti

viśvataścakṣuruta viśvatomukho viśvatobāhuruta viśvataspāt ityādiśrutīnāmapyatraiva
sāmañjasyamityāśayenāha - sarvatreti

vivekasyaivottāraṇatvaṃ vaktuṃ saṃsāraṃ samudratayā rūpayati - agādheti
dvābhyām
